newsitem.title: USA: TIG earnings growth could moderate in '97.
newsitem.headline: TIG earnings growth could moderate in '97.

text.p: TIG Holdings Inc said the company's earnings growth could be moderated in 1997 because of competitive market conditions.

TIG chief executive Jon Rotenstreich said competitive market conditions in the commercial insurance and reinsurance industry have encouraged the company to remain selective in its underwriting process.
"We do not anticipate any change in pricing conditions during 1997; therefore these conditions could moderate earnings growth until our recent initiatives reach full production," he said.
TIG earlier reported first quarter operating earnings of $0.62 a share compared with the First Call consensus of $0.68 a share.
TIG shares fell 3-1/2, or more than 11 percent, to 27-7/8 in midmorning trade.
